integrity_checker_scope: record/source/byte/hash assertions; controller_contact, production_or_mounted_volume_tests and installed_application_modified are action-scope attestations from reviewed fixture sources/guarded results, not global packet capture

runtime_hash_scope_definitions.Runtime.jdk/Contents/Home files only: Fresh Home file-content-map digest excluding modes
runtime_hash_scope_definitions.Runtime.jdk files and file_modes: Fresh digest({files: file-content map, file_modes: mode map}); matches exact vendor lock/gate/package digest; directory modes separately verified

installed_reference_mode_scope: Modes match preserved external reference; content independently pinned to tracked intake map. Initial reference modes were not separately hash-pinned in intake.
action_scope_attestation: No Main/native GUI/controller/production volume operations performed: reviewed fixture entrypoints plus OfflineGuard zero-denial assertions. Not independently established by packet capture.

qualification_interpreter_attestation.measurement_phase: Final ledger verification; each qualification entrypoint invokes verify_python, corrected bundle/test orchestration explicitly selects sys.executable. Path not separately captured at every gate start.

checked_source_hash_entries_definition: Count of all asserted reported source-hash entries plus Python test source entries, including repeated files; not unique-file count.
supplemental_record_scope: Bundle/run results are this independent ledger checker summaries, hashes identify those summaries; diagnostics assertions verify their pass/source/architecture/artifact claims, not new behavior tests.

excluded_runs.development: Dirty drafts, initial pop opcode corrected to pop2, classallowlist correction, worker-identity fixture corrections, and sourceguard-rejected run excluded. Separate dirty dev-admission-4 run passed40 checks and is not clean acceptance; earlier expanded dev-admission-3 run was rejected on source changes.
excluded_runs.initial_package_interpreter: One initial orchestration attempt per architecture used python3 resolved by isolated PATH to an unpinned Python; rejected before package copy. Corrected to sys.executable pinned CPython3.14.8; no source change.
excluded_runs.historical_audit19: Earlier lock stdout mismatch remains unexplained; audit20 does not claim a cause or fix.

limits: External stopped async callbacks deliberately run on EDT and can precede older drain/nonEDT return, show errors/model changes, or cause extension repost event loops. Disposed AppContext can drop events; scheduling/link errors propagate outside queue. Production logger emits only its existing limited ERROR signal. Constructor bypass, absent connection, headless EventQueue and arbitrary third-party callback limits are in admission record. Active send/shutdown races, interruption orphaning, abnormal unstopped worker exit, native GUI, physical Intel, production controller/volume behavior and signing/notarization remain unqualified.
final_evidence_refinements: After actual Claude follow-up: application_source_commit checked; missing top-level fields use fixture commit plus per-row current/original JAR pairs, runtime Home digest bound to each architecture, exact factory pairs and connect/lock counts derived, diagnostics pass/source/arch/tree checked, installed contents intake-pinned. Summaries are identified as ledger outputs rather than extra tests; action-scope attestations and interpreter measurement phase explicit. Qualification inputs unchanged.
